def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 155, 151, 154, 156, 157, 158, 160, 162, 161, 159]
    lookback_period = 5

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    window = closing_prices[-lookback_period:]
    rank = sorted(window).index(closing_prices[-1]) + 1
    answer = (100 / (lookback_period - 1)) * (rank - 1)

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 2)
